warning_texts: The machine gate has no rule over the hypothesis blocks in analysis/answers/ (effect_name, method, alpha) nor over delivered/net wording in the AOV caveats; both blockers above sit in that unchecked space, and claims_are_single_assertions reports 'all roles in p' for the test claims although their s

Both test p-values are stored as 0.0000000000 and render at display_digits 4 as 0.0000; the recomputed two-proportion p is about 2.9e-157 and the Welch p underflows double precision, so the release should render them as below 0.0001 rather than as an exact zero.

Both tests declare correction bonferroni with alpha 0.05, but no adjusted per-test alpha (0.025 for two tests) is recorded anywhere; the conclusions are unaffected because both p-values are far below any threshold, yet the correction is named rather than shown as applied.

The AOV test compares delivered orders only, as the plan registered; the AOV difference is therefore conditional on delivery and should not be read as a difference in value per order placed, given that direct also delivers a larger share.
